name: whimsical
title: Whimsical
description: Generate AI diagrams and browse your Whimsical workspace. Create flowcharts, mindmaps, and sequence diagrams with AI, plus browse and search your workspace files using the official Whimsical Public API.
author: kud

commands.name: browse-files
commands.title: Browse Workspace
commands.description: Navigate your Whimsical workspace hierarchy: teams → projects → files/folders

commands.name: search-content
commands.title: Search Whimsical Content
commands.description: Search through your Whimsical files and content

tools.name: diagram
tools.title: Whimsical Diagram
tools.description: Generate flowcharts, mindmaps, or sequence diagrams using AI. Just describe what you want and the AI will choose the best diagram type and create it for you.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
